phase: Reference Mode Recovery — Government Effective Interest Rate
purpose: Materialize the official Ministry of Finance year-end average interest rate of the government-debt portfolio as the empirical reference mode for government_effective_interest_rate, while keeping its source definition distinct from Eurostat apparent cost, realized cash interest, marginal market yields and the unobserved repricing transition parameter.
promotion_rule: Promote government_effective_interest_rate to OBSERVED_SERIES_AVAILABLE only if all ten 2014-2023 MoF values are finite and unique by year, every documented overlapping Ministry strategy observation is exactly consistent, the retained 2019-2023 legacy series matches exactly, and the source definition/provenance explicitly preserves the MoF portfolio-cost boundary. Promotion makes an annual observed reference target available but does not validate or activate the government refinancing/effective-rate mechanism.
negative_result_rule: Any overlap inconsistency, missing year, non-finite value or definition mismatch leaves the mode blocked. Eurostat apparent cost, D41PAY/debt ratios, market yields or interpolation may not be used to fill a failure.
